summary: Verified the requirements' end-to-end trace against source and mapped the full blast radius; root cause confirmed (reworkExistingPr never calls updatePR). Surfaced a key new finding: the body/title are LLM-generated, so 'regenerate from diff -> no-op when unchanged' is not deterministic, which breaks naive change-detection.

details.root_cause: src/core/orchestrator/pipeline/delivery/create-pr.ts:69-95 (reworkExistingPr) dismisses approval + marks feedback applied but never reads pr-description.md and never calls hosting.updatePR; only openNewPr (:131-182) pushes the description.
key_findings: pr-description.ts regenerates the BODY narrative from the full diff against base on every non-push-only re-entry (no trivial-skip); deliverable is body-only (pr-description.md).

PR title today is the static task title via composePrTitle(ctx.task.title,...) (create-pr.ts:149) -- NOT diff-derived; no mechanism produces a title from the work. schemas/task.ts:106 comment calling it 'AI-generated' is stale.

updatePR + PRUpdates(title,body,draft,labels) exist and the GitHub plugin applies them (null=no-change); ZERO callers in src/core/orchestrator. composePrBody/composePrTitle are pure, exported, unit-tested -- reusable.
No host read of current title/body exists (PRStatus lacks both); pr-description.md is overwritten each round -- so 'push only when changed' has no off-the-shelf baseline to compare against.

CRITICAL: body (and any LLM-derived title) are agent-generated, so regenerating the same diff can reword the prose -> exact-match change-detection will produce spurious updates on no-op rounds, contradicting the owner's deterministic 'natural no-op' assumption.
files_likely_change_depending_on_design: src/schemas/task.ts (ReviewState field to store last-pushed presentation, if store-and-compare chosen)
src/schemas/adapters.ts + src/adapters/git-hosting.ts + github-hosting plugin + git-hosting contract suite (only if 'read live body' baseline chosen -- higher cost)
details.tests: Primary unit surface: tests/unit/core/orchestrator/pipeline/delivery/create-pr.test.ts (mockCtx hosting needs updatePR added; add changed/unchanged cases). fake-git-hosting stores title/body on pr.options. No integration test currently covers the reworkExistingPr (pr_number set) path.
details.human_questions: none -- owner settled all product decisions; remaining forks (change-detection baseline, LLM-nondeterminism handling, title generation, best-effort-vs-blocking) are planning-phase design decisions the owner explicitly delegated.
